items_v1:
This is a top-down camera view of a miniature warehouse floor. A small mobile robot with a front gripper must pick up one small loose cargo item.
List every small loose cargo item lying on the floor that such a robot could carry (for example a small cube or block, possibly sitting on a small pallet) and every small empty pallet.
Do NOT list traffic cones, fixed machines, robot arms, shelves, vehicles, drums, floor markings or large stacks of goods.
Return JSON only, no prose:
{"items": [{"type": "cube_on_pallet" | "loose_cube" | "empty_pallet" | "other_small_item", "color": <main colour>, "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "description": <short phrase>}]}
bbox_2d are integers normalized to 0-1000 relative to this image. If there is no such item, return {"items": []}.

Site knowledge: in this site a small pallet is a square grey slatted plate, about as wide as the base of a traffic cone; seen from above it looks like a small grey grate lying on the black floor. The cargo is a small red cube that sits on top of such a pallet.
List every small pallet that carries a red cube (type cube_on_pallet) and every small pallet that carries nothing (type empty_pallet).
Do NOT list traffic cones, fixed machines, robot arms, shelves, vehicles, drums, floor markings, large pallets or large stacks of goods.
Return JSON only, no prose:
{"items": [{"type": "cube_on_pallet" | "loose_cube" | "empty_pallet" | "other_small_item", "color": <main colour>, "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "description": <short phrase>}]}
bbox_2d are integers normalized to 0-1000 relative to this image. If there is no such item, return {"items": []}.
items_v3:
This is a top-down camera view of a miniature warehouse floor. A small mobile robot with a front gripper must pick up one small loose cargo item.
Site knowledge: in this site a small pallet is a square GREY slatted plate lying flat on the black floor; seen from above it looks like a small grey grate. In this image a small pallet is about one tenth of the image width (bbox about 100 units wide and 150-200 units high). The cargo is a small red cube that sits on top of such a grey pallet.
List every small grey pallet. Use type cube_on_pallet only if a red cube is clearly visible on it, otherwise type empty_pallet. Report each pallet exactly once.
Do NOT list traffic cones, fixed machines, robot arms, shelves, racks, vehicles, drums, posts, signs, floor markings, objects that are not grey plates, large pallets or large stacks of goods.
Return JSON only, no prose:
{"items": [{"type": "cube_on_pallet" | "loose_cube" | "empty_pallet" | "other_small_item", "color": <main colour>, "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "description": <short phrase>}]}
bbox_2d are integers normalized to 0-1000 relative to this image. If there is no such item, return {"items": []}.
landmarks:
This is a top-down camera view of a miniature logistics work floor.
Locate each of the following if it is visible: (1) the truck, (2) the truck loading bay = the marked parking space where the truck stands, (3) the conveyor belt production line, (4) the charging station, (5) the pedestrian walkway, (6) the mobile robot = the wheeled ground vehicle that drives on the floor (not a fixed robot arm).
Return JSON only, no prose:
{"objects": [{"label": "truck" | "loading_bay" | "conveyor" | "charging_station" | "walkway" | "mobile_robot", "bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "visual_evidence": <short phrase>}]}
bbox_2d are integers normalized to 0-1000 relative to this image. Omit a label that is not visible.
